description: This file defines a React-like component named 'Pagination' using Qwik framework. It handles pagination UI with previous/next buttons and page info display. It imports external types and functions from Qwik and local types, and exports the 'Pagination' component as well as a default export.

methods.name: Pagination
methods.description: A Qwik component rendering pagination controls with previous/next buttons and page info.
